register_page.title: Title
register_page.different_mail_address: I get my mail at a different address
register_page.changed_address: I have changed my address since the last time I registered to vote
register_page.name_help: Put your full name and in these boxes. Please do not use nicknames or initials. If this application is for a change of name you will be asked for your previous name in a later section. And don't forget to include your title (Mr., Mrs., Miss, Ms.). The pre-determined options for the Title field are dictated by the National Mail Voter Registration Form, and this field is required by some states. They are not reflective of Rock the Vote's views or values on gender inclusivity.
register_page.changed_name_help: If you have changed your name since your last registration, enter your previous name.
register_page.age_eligibility: I will be 18 or older by the next election.
register_page.address_help: Put your home address in these boxes. Do not put your mailing address here if it is different from your home address. Do not use a post office box or rural route without a box number. If you live in a rural area or do not have a street address, please show where you live using the map on the printed form.
register_page.changed_address_help: If you have moved since your last registration, enter your previous address.
register_page.has_id: I have a {{abbreviation}} state identification card or {{abbreviation}} driver's license.
register_page.no_id: I do not have a {{abbreviation}} state identification card or {{abbreviation}} driver's license.
register_page.driver_license: You must provide your valid {{name}} driver license number or a {{name}} nondriver identification number. If you do not have a valid {{name}} driver license or a {state.name} nondriver identification number, provide the last four digits of your social security number. If you do not have any of these, you may only register at the county auditor's office.
register_page.ssn_help: You must provide your full Social Security number.
register_page.race_help: The state of {{name}} does not request information about your race or ethnicity. However, we would appreciate this information to measure the effectiveness of our voter registration efforts.

register_page.dob_help: On your voter registration application, you are required to indicate whether you will be 18 years old on or before election day. However, many states allow you to register before your 18th birthday, so please click here to see the rule for your state.
register_page.phone_help: Most states ask for your telephone number in case there are questions about your application. You are not required to provide your phone number.
register_page.sms_opt_in: Send me text messages from Rock the Vote
register_page.sms_disclaimer: By signing up, you consent to receive periodic text messages from Rock the Vote (788683). Message and data rates may apply. Text HELP for info or STOP to stop receiving messages. No purchase necessary. See terms and conditions and privacy policy.
register_page.email_opt_in: Receive action alerts and other email updates from Rock the Vote
register_page.volunteer: I would like to volunteer with Rock the Vote
register_page.mail_form: Please mail me my form, I can't print it right now
